claim: Correctness of Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507's first-attempt code on 444 LiveCodeBench tasks is linearly decodable from the final-prompt-token hidden state before any output token, with leakage-free held-out AUC 0.881 ± 0.008 over 50 outer splits.
stance_target: pre-generation probes occupy a facet of L2
quoted_support: The correctness of the model’s first-attempt code is linearly decodable from the hidden state at the final prompt token, captured before any output token is generated, with a leakage-free held-out AUC of 0.881 ± 0.008 across 50 outer splits.

breadth.confidence_families: Linear probe on prompt-final hidden state only (PCA 95% + L2 logistic regression); prompt-length baselines (Sec 3.1)
breadth.reasoning_models: not present (searched: model is the non-thinking Instruct-2507 variant; no reasoning-mode comparison)
breadth.elicitation_formats: not present (no verbal or sampled readouts; hidden state at last prompt token before generation, Sec 2.2)
breadth.label_independence: Label is the probed model's own attempt-0 output (same model)
breadth.contamination_split: LiveCodeBench cited as contamination-free benchmark (ref [6]) but no release-date vs cutoff split is run; 50 random stratified 80/20 splits with nested CV (Sec 3.1-3.2)
breadth.calibration_metrics: AUC only: raw 0.881 ± 0.008, residualized 0.842 ± 0.010, prompt-length 0.657 ± 0.014 (Table 3); no ECE/Brier
breadth.causal_intervention: not present (searched: no steering/ablation; residualization against prompt length is a confound control only)

claim: After residualizing each hidden dimension against prompt length the probe retains AUC 0.842 ± 0.010 versus a prompt-length-only baseline of 0.657 ± 0.014; nonlinear prompt-length models (RF 0.642, GB 0.649, MLP 0.657) do not exceed the logistic baseline.
quoted_support: The probe still achieves an AUC of 0.842 ± 0.010 , substantially above a logistic prompt-length baseline of 0.657 ± 0.014 , and none of the nonlinear models tested improves upon it.

claim: Layer choice is made by nested CV: layer 30 is modal (16 of 50 outer splits), layer 29 next (13), layer 33 (8); per-layer test AUC plateau 0.880-0.884 across layers 29-36.
quoted_support: The modal selection across the 50 splits is layer 30 with C = 0.001 , chosen in 16 of them.

claim: Self-repair data are starved: of 266 first-attempt failures only 20 recover within 5 attempts (14 at the first repair); conditional pass rate falls from 40.1% at attempt 0 to 5.3%, 2.0%, 0.4%, 0%.
stance_target: L3 observed-failure update: repair signal null
scope_conditions: Sec 4; one 4B model; repair prompt includes verifier error output
quoted_support: Of the 266 tasks whose first attempt fails, only 20 ever recover within the 5-attempt budget, 14 of them at the first repair, and the conditional pass rate among still-unsolved tasks collapses from 40.1% at attempt 0 to 5.3%, 2.0%, 0.4% and 0% at attempts 1 through 4.

stance_target: L2 gap: pre-generation vs post-generation, multi-model replication left open
quoted_support: In both, the hidden state is read after the model has produced an answer.
